top_issues: The 'How to read this' explainer card occupies ~25% of the first screen and overlaps below the fold; returning users see it every time unless 'Got it' persists.

Four-segment stacked bar (on-chain/reserve/secured/promised) has three near-identical green squares and two zero-value segments; the legend row wraps and 'Secured $0.00' reads as money when it is zero.
'Instant: send up to $175, receive up to $250.75' is a violet text line directly above three CTAs; it mixes a capacity fact with the action row and is easy to miss.
Balances section header shares a row with two actions ('Add money', 'Move') and a toggle ('Show 1 empty') — four competing affordances at the same level.
fixes: Persist 'Got it' and collapse the explainer to a one-line '? how to read' link; keep only the stacked bar on first paint.
Drop zero segments from the bar and their legend chips until non-zero; keep promised violet always visible.
Move the instant-capacity line into the Pay flow and under the account card on Home; reserve the CTA row for actions only.
Move 'Add money' and 'Move' into the asset row as trailing icons; keep 'Show empty' in Settings.

top_issues: Account card: '+115.00 owes you' pairs a positive-looking number with an ambiguous direction; 'owes you' is set smaller than the number so the sign reads first.
The account progress bar (green/violet + marker) has no axis; 'send up to 175.00 / receive up to 0.50' sits on a second line detached from the bar ends.
Activity rows mix a status dot + word (settled/open/closed) with left-edge colored ticks whose meaning is never explained on this screen.
WETH 0.00 row floats above the accounts card with no section header after scrolling, orphaned context.
fixes: Rewrite as 'You are owed 115.00' with the number in violet, matching the promised color elsewhere.
Attach 'send up to' / 'receive up to' labels directly under their bar ends; add a thin tick marker legend.
Either drop the left ticks or add one shared legend; keep status dot+word as the only status encoding.
Give the scrolled region a sticky 'ACCOUNTS' header so the WETH row never floats context-free.

top_issues: The 'Your account with H1' mini-bar inside the Amount card duplicates the bar shown on Home; the tick marker is unexplained.
Route card mixes four key-value rows with a collapsed '1 OTHER ROUTE' disclosure; route chips You→H1→H2 are small touch targets.
Full recipient hex address shown twice in the To card (monospace wrap) dominates the card height without a copy action.
fixes: Show the account bar only once; in the Pay flow reduce it to 'send up to 175.00 instantly' text.
Raise route chip height to ≥40 px and make the whole route row tappable for alternatives.
Truncate to 0x92c2…cbf0 with a copy icon; full address behind a tap.

top_issues: Expanded route comparison shows two cards with identical 'You send 25.00' and fees differing in the fifth decimal (0.000050 vs 0.000075); no total-cost or arrival difference to justify the choice.
Cropped top of screen shows the address hex half-clipped under the header; scroll anchoring loses the To card.
'Up to 180.00 instantly' differs from 'Up to 175.00 instantly' on the previous screen with no explanation of the delta.
fixes: Collapse near-identical routes into one row: '2 routes · fee ≤0.0001 · instant'; expand only on tap.
Keep the To card sticky or show a compact 'to H2 ✓' chip in the header when scrolled.
State why capacity changed (e.g. 'reserved for this payment') or use one consistent number.

top_issues: 'Settled 05:02:18 · in 9 s' combines a wall-clock time with a duration; two time semantics on one row.
Frame #73 and Proof hash are shown but not tappable; no way to inspect or export from this surface without leaving.
Four footer buttons (Copy receipt / Download / Print / PDF / Done) are equal weight; Done should dominate on mobile.
fixes: Split: 'Settled in 9 s' as headline; timestamp as secondary line.
Make Frame and Proof rows tappable with a copy/share icon each.
Full-width Done; move Copy/Download/Print into a 'share receipt' row of icons.

top_issues: Dimmed background still shows the total balance dropping $155→$130 behind the sheet; the eye is drawn to the unexplained change before the receipt.
Sheet occupies ~70% of screen; the 'Verified by your runtime' trust line sits low, below the fold on smaller phones.
Same four-button footer balance issue as 03-receipt.png.
fixes: Dim the background further (≥80% scrim) so the balance change does not compete with the confirmation.
Move 'Verified by your runtime' directly under the amount, above Settled/Frame/Proof.
See 03-receipt fix: single Done + icon row.

top_issues: 'Prepare incoming account · H1 Testnet' with 'Capacity is checked for this account. The sender chooses the final route.' is protocol jargon a first-time receiver cannot act on; it looks like a required step but is not.
QR is very large and the address is not shown as text near it; no copy button on this screen at all.
'25.50 capacity via H1' floats in the amount field header, unlabeled — capacity of what, for the payer or for you?
fixes: Collapse the prepare-account card to an advanced disclosure; receivers need only QR + link.
Show address text under the QR with a copy button; move 'Copy payment link' up beside the QR.
Relabel to 'A hub can route up to 25.50 to you instantly'.

top_issues: 'YOUR ENTITY ID 0x8fc3e550…1aee22' plus the paragraph 'Anyone with an account route to you can pay this id directly' is two concepts (entity id vs route) exposed raw; Noah will map it, Lucas will not.
'Other ways to share' disclosure is the only path to QR-rescan/NFC etc.; unclear what is hidden.
No amount confirmation preview: after typing an amount the share text is not shown before copying.
fixes: Rename to 'Your address' and cut the paragraph to one line: 'Anyone can pay this id instantly.'
List share options inline as small chips (Link, QR, PDF) instead of a disclosure.
Preview the link/QR payload in a bordered box before the copy action.

top_issues: The collateral-tariff paragraph ('0.1 WETH base + 0 WETH gas + 1 bps… policy and balance at that time') is 6 lines of hedge language inside a trade ticket; it reads like a disclaimer and erodes confidence in the quoted number.
'You receive' amount is grey (disabled-look) while it is the primary output of the swap.
Lot rounding '0.000004 USDC stays with you' is good, but 'Hub fee 1 bps · up to 0.0000 WETH' shows a zero range with 'up to' — ambiguous.
fixes: Replace the paragraph with one line: 'Net after H1 tariff: 0.0399xx WETH (est.)'; move detail behind the settings link.
Render received amount in white or accent; grey implies unavailable.
Show 'Hub fee 1 bps' and drop the zero 'up to' clause when it is zero.

top_issues: Order book has no mid-price highlight or 'your order' marker; the highlighted 2,498.0000 row is unexplained (cursor? best bid? hover?).
Depth bars start at a common left edge but have no scale reference; sizes 10–30 WETH look similar in length.
'Tap a level to fill the ticket at that price' hint is plain text at the card bottom — it is an interaction model, should be discoverable not documented.
fixes: Label the highlighted row (e.g. 'selected') and add a subtle mid-spread divider marker.
Add a max-size reference tick or scale label at the bar origin.
Convert the hint into a one-time coach mark on first book view.

top_issues: A toast ('Account opening requested with zero credit…') permanently overlaps the 'Prepare to receive' card it describes; on this screenshot it obscures content and never dismisses.
Cross-network swap requires reading three stacked concepts before acting: other account, hub there, prepare-to-receive slider — heavy for Aisha's task.
'Quoted at the best price… order rests on your account until H1 fills it' text is duplicated verbatim from the same-network swap though settlement here is atomic.
fixes: Auto-dismiss toasts after 4 s and anchor them below the header, never over interactive cards.
Collapse 'Your other account' + 'Hub there' into one row: 'via H3 on Tron'.
Tailor the quote sentence per mode (atomic both-legs vs resting order).

top_issues: The collateral slider defaults to 0% with a red warning 'Prepare incoming capacity before swapping'; the failure path is the first thing a user meets, with no default-safe option (e.g. quote a smaller amount).
'New credit 0.008798 WETH' and 'Permanent limit you grant H3: 0.00 → 0.008798 WETH' conflate two numbers (credit needed vs permanent limit) in near-identical figures.
Precision noise: '0.008798', '0.0008 buffer' — six decimals of WETH on a $20 swap is unreadable.
fixes: When capacity is short, propose the largest feasible amount inline ('Swap 15 instead of 20') instead of only a red error.
Separate rows: 'Credit needed now: 0.0088 WETH' and 'Permanent limit for H3 (optional): +0.0088'.
Round display to 4 significant decimals; keep exact values in a detail tap.

top_issues: Five-tab action grid (Pay / Extend credit / Swap / Manage / Dispute) puts a destructive rare action (Dispute) at the same visual rank as Pay.
Legend row (secured/promised/you owe/credit room/in flight) with five swatches is dense; 'in flight' hatch swatch is illegible at that size.
USDC card states '+90.00 they owe you' but Home said '+90.00 owes you' then 'They owe you, uncovered $90.00' — three phrasings for one number.
fixes: Move Dispute into Manage; keep 3 primary actions + Manage.
Reduce legend to the three colors actually on screen; explain 'in flight' only when non-zero.
Standardize on 'They owe you' everywhere, uncovered amount violet.

top_issues: 'This account' table is strong but 'If you dispute, they answer within 1 d' mixes a condition with a deadline; the 1 d clock start is undefined.
'Frames signed 15' is protocol vocabulary with no user value at this position.
Credit lines to/from are shown twice on this screen (top card and this table) with identical zeros.
fixes: Rewrite: 'On dispute, the chain waits 1 day for a newer signed page.'
Move 'Frames signed' into Ledger detail; keep the exposure table financial only.
Deduplicate: keep credit-line rows only in the ledger section.

top_issues: Dispute copy is excellent but the confirm button 'Dispute this account…' is styled as a disabled-looking muted red; the ellipsis suggests more steps that are not shown.
No summary of consequences for this specific account (you would claim $90 uncovered + $60 collateral) — the copy is generic while the stakes are concrete.
The four Manage tabs (Collateral/Credit/Add token/Dispute) give no indication of which states are risky.
fixes: Make the final button solid red with a two-step hold-to-confirm; drop the ellipsis.
Add a stake box: 'If the chain finalizes now you receive $60 collateral + $90 claim.'
Add per-tab risk badges (e.g. Collateral: 0 posted).

top_issues: Same sheet appears twice in the set with no state change; no confirmation step or post-submit state is shown, leaving the flow's end unjudged.
Numbered steps use 'page' metaphor ('the latest page both of you signed') while every other screen says 'frame'; terminology split.
Background account card is heavily dimmed but the action grid buttons remain colored, drawing attention away from the sheet.
fixes: Include the pending/confirmed dispute state in the set; add a hold-to-confirm before the red button fires.
Unify on 'frame' (or 'statement') across product copy.
Dim the entire background layer uniformly, including the action grid.

top_issues: 'Swap closed 05:02:10' row has no amount at all and a grey 'closed' dot; cannot tell if it made or lost money.
'Export CSV' sits top-center as a text link between the title and count — an audit action with equal weight as navigation.
Status words settle/open/closed/created are four states with three colors (green/amber/grey); 'closed' vs 'settled' distinction is invisible.
Filter chips scroll off-screen ('Accou…' clipped) with no fade hint.
fixes: Give swap rows a signed amount and net result (+/−).
Move Export CSV into an overflow menu; keep title + count in the header.
Use filled vs hollow dots and one accent for terminal states; label 'closed' as 'filled'.
Add an edge fade on the chip row to signal scrollability.

top_issues: 'Frames 2 committed entries' row is opaque; the count without hashes or links cannot be verified.
To address shown as 'H2 0x92c2d7…cbf0' inline; copying the address alone is not possible.
'From your runtime's committed frames' is jargon for a receipt provenance line.
fixes: Make the Frames row expandable to list the two frame hashes.
Separate name and address into two rows with independent copy.
Rewrite: 'Proof comes from your own signed records.'

top_issues: The 'Dollars per pixel' scale concept requires a paragraph to explain and a slider plus six preset chips; it is a power feature occupying the top of Settings.
The three HOME toggles (On-chain wallet / Reserve / Accounts) look like display switches but actually change what money you hold — risk of misread as cosmetic.
'Layout on wide screens Comfort/Desk' includes ⌘K mention on mobile where no keyboard exists.
fixes: Move the scale control into the 'At this scale' card on Settings as an advanced item below Vault.
Restyle the HOME toggles as destination cards with balances, not switches.
Drop the ⌘K sentence from mobile copy.

top_issues: 'AT THIS SCALE $100 = 10 px … A bar wider than its card fades out at the edge' documents a rendering artifact instead of fixing it; fading bars undermine the one-scale promise.
'Forget vault' destructive button sits directly under 'Reveal recovery phrase' with only color separating it from safe actions.
'Runtime id' full hex shown with no copy action; 'Mode embedded' is undefined vocabulary.
fixes: Cap bars at card width with a '> $X' overflow label instead of fading.
Move Forget vault behind a confirmation sheet and separate it by a divider.
Add copy icons for Runtime id and Signer; tooltip-define 'Mode'.

top_issues: FROM/TO card grids repeat identical three-cell rows; each cell repeats the description text ('On-chain, in your signer' etc.) making the screen text-heavy.
'Account Bilateral, instant 150.00 USDC' as a FROM option conflicts with the $90 owed figure elsewhere; 150 is capacity not balance, unlabeled.
Amount 'up to 40.00 USDC' but selected FROM Reserve is 40 while TO Account shows 150 — the cap logic is invisible.
fixes: Show descriptions once in a legend; keep cells to name + amount + mini-bar.
Label account cells 'capacity' vs 'owed' explicitly.
Echo the applied cap next to the amount: 'limited by Reserve balance 40.00'.

top_issues: 'WHAT HAPPENS · Fund you through H1' explains a Reserve→Account move as 'posts collateral on-chain' — but the user is moving their own money; the framing inverts who funds whom.
Two equal buttons 'Sign & send' and 'Add to batch' split the primary action; batch is an advanced concept shown first-run.
'Recipient entity · leave empty for yourself' raw hex field on a consumer flow.
fixes: Rewrite per direction: 'Moves $25 of your escrow into your H1 account as collateral.'
Collapse 'Add to batch' into an overflow; keep one primary CTA.
Hide the entity field unless paying someone else; default self.

top_issues: 'WHERE YOUR MONEY STANDS' repeats Home's bar legend copy nearly verbatim — duplicated education.
Five entry tiles (Sovereignty/Move/Assets/Lending/Ownership) share one icon (shield) twice for different concepts.
'NEEDS ATTENTION · Nothing waiting on you.' is a whole card for a null state; consumes prime space.
fixes: Cut the legend to one line and link to Home's explainer instead of restating.
Differentiate icons per tile.
Render null state as a single line, not a card.

top_issues: 'Depository may pull 0.00' on every token row is allowance jargon; three rows of it with zero values.
'Move into reserve' button is narrow and left-aligned with an arrow-only icon; its label wraps under the icon awkwardly.
Gas 0.1000 ETH shown without fiat equivalent; Rosa cannot judge whether that is enough.
fixes: Show allowances only when non-zero; label 'approved spending'.
Make Move into reserve a full-width secondary button.
Append '≈ $X' to Gas.

top_issues: 'FAUCETS · Test money from the network you are connected to.' is cut mid-word at the fold; the primary testnet onboarding action is below the fold.
'H1 POOL' numbers (Available/Borrowed/Active principal) all zero with no explanation of whose money — the pool's or yours.
No empty-state guidance connecting Assets→Faucets→first deposit.
fixes: Pin Faucets above the fold on testnet with a one-tap claim.
Label pool rows: 'Pool size (all lenders)' etc.
Add a first-run checklist: get test ETH → get test USDC → open account.

top_issues: The lending form stacks Hub selector, three token cards, Lend/Borrow toggle, amount, three terms, bps input — seven decision blocks before any rate context; no market rate to anchor '100 bps'.
'= 1.00% per term' lacks a currency/annualized translation and what happens at default.
'Offer to the pool' button is in a muted/disabled-looking state with no reason shown (amount 0).
Lending implies lending to a hub with counterparty risk, but no risk disclosure or collateral terms are shown here.
fixes: Show comparable pool rates next to the bps input and a projected return line.
Add one line: 'Unsecured claim on H1 at term end' plus link to terms.
Enable the button only when valid and label why it is disabled ('enter an amount').

top_issues: 'Your offer sits in the hub pool until borrowed; principal and interest come back on your account with the hub at term end.' is the only risk explanation and reads as guaranteed.
H1 POOL all-zero table under the form suggests an illiquid pool without saying so.
Term buttons wrap 2+1 asymmetrically; '1 month' alone on the second row.
fixes: Rephrase with risk: '…if H1 repays; see collateral and dispute terms.'
Add pool utilization badge (e.g. '0% utilized · new').
Use a 3-across term row or a segmented control.

top_issues: 'Kind: Self-issued (its id is the hash of its board)' plus 'A lazy entity is identified by the hash of its board. Register it on the EntityProvider…' — internal protocol terms (lazy entity, EntityProvider) surface raw.
'TAKE CONTROL OF ANOTHER ENTITY · Nothing to take over…' is an alarming headline for an empty state.
The long rotation paragraph is good documentation but wrong altitude for a mobile card.
fixes: Relabel Kind to 'Single key (advanced: self-issued)' and move lazy-entity text behind a docs link.
Rename the empty state to 'No other entities list your key.'
Collapse the rotation explainer to 2 lines + 'Learn more'.

top_issues: 'Enforceable right now $40.00' is the best number in the product but the green/violet bar below still shows the same Home legend needing re-reading.
'Frame #82 · signed just now' with two runtime hex ids on one card is dense; Signer and Entity ids look interchangeable.
'Inside: 1 account · H1 at frame #15 … Nothing in it lets anyone spend.' mixes inventory with a security disclaimer.
fixes: Keep the number; drop the repeated legend, keep only the violet promised line.
Differentiate rows: 'Your key' vs 'Your entity', with copy icons.
Split the bundle explanation into a 'What's inside' disclosure.

top_issues: 'Can dispute without asking 1 of 1' phrasing is ambiguous (asking whom?).
'Save evidence bundle' is the key audit action but styled as a quiet secondary button.
'they answer in 1 d, you in 1 d' truncates mid-clause on the per-counterparty row.
fixes: Rewrite: 'You can open a dispute on your own (no approval needed).'
Promote Save evidence bundle to a bordered primary in the LEDGER card.
Shorten to 'response window 1 d each way'.

overall.verdict: A genuinely advanced wallet whose honest green/violet enforceable-vs-promised framing is best-in-class, with strong receipts, dispute copy and per-counterparty proofs. It is held back by protocol jargon leaking into consumer flows (entity id, frames, capacity, tariffs), duplicated education cards, ambiguous status words, and a default-to-0%-collateral failure path in cross-network swaps that punishes exactly the users it should protect.
priority_fixes: Replace the 0%-collateral default + red error in cross-network receive with a safe proposal (largest feasible amount or one-tap 100% collateral) — fixes Aisha, Rosa, Lucas.
Strip or collapse jargon: entity id → 'address', frames → hidden behind ledger detail, capacity → 'instant limit', tariff paragraph → one net line — fixes Rosa, Lucas, Priya, Noah stays honest.

Standardize status language and encodings: one owed phrasing ('They owe you'), one status set (settled/open/filled) with distinct dot styles, and amounts on swap-closed rows — fixes Jamal, Priya, Wei.
Deduplicate the green/violet explainer to a single dismissible one-liner and remove zero-value bar segments; label account cells as capacity vs owed — fixes Rosa, Ingrid, Omar.
Restructure risky flows: Dispute out of the top-level action grid into Manage with hold-to-confirm and a stake summary; promote Save evidence bundle; separate Forget vault — fixes Elena, Ingrid.

personas.name: Rosa
personas.verdict: I can see my 155 dollars in big numbers, but half the screen is explaining colored bars to me and I would not trust 'promised' money I cannot hold.
blockers: 01-home: explainer card and four-part legend require reading to know what is safe.
Small violet/grey secondary text throughout; color-plus-word is good but words are tiny.
Send $50 works, but the 'promised' vs 'secured' distinction is never made reassuring in plain language on the confirmation.

personas.name: Jamal
personas.verdict: Watching payments arrive is easy and 'instantly' is clear, but several small receipts a day give me no daily total and swap rows without amounts are noise.
blockers: 07-activity: no day-summary or running total for many small receipts.
07-activity: 'Swap closed' row has no amount, so scanning is interrupted.
Cashing out requires the Move screen where capacity vs balance labels are ambiguous (10-move).

personas.name: Priya
personas.verdict: Showing a QR with an amount is fast and 'settled' badges are great at closing time, but there is no end-of-day reconciliation view or export per shift.
blockers: 04-receive: 'Prepare incoming account' card confuses the counter flow and hides the QR copy action.
07-activity: Export CSV exists but no filtered date/shift range is visible.
No merchant summary (count, total settled today) anywhere.

personas.name: Wei
personas.verdict: The book, limit entry and bilateral settlement line are serious trader fare, but depth bars have no scale and the fee/hedge paragraph reads like the venue is unsure of its own number.
blockers: 05-swap-bottom: no size scale or cumulative depth on the book.
05-swap: collateral-tariff uncertainty paragraph under a live quote.
06-account: exposure per counterparty is good but there is no aggregate open-order/fill list screen in the set.

personas.name: Elena
personas.verdict: Signed-by-both-sides framing, proof hashes, CSV export and an evidence bundle are exactly what an audit needs; they are just buried one level too deep.
blockers: 15-sovereignty-bottom: Save evidence bundle is a low-emphasis button.
08-activity-detail: 'Frames 2 committed entries' cannot be expanded to actual hashes.
No statement/PDF for a date range — only per-item receipts and CSV.

personas.name: Noah
personas.verdict: I can map accounts, frames, credit, collateral and disputes to the protocol almost perfectly from the UI; 'lazy entity' and 'capacity' are the only misleads.
blockers: 14-ownership: 'lazy entity'/'EntityProvider' jargon conflicts with the rest of the model.
04-receive: 'capacity' conflates inbound credit room with routing.
No screen shows the candidate/consensus layer, so frame timing ('in 9 s') is unexplained.

personas.name: Aisha
personas.verdict: Cross-network payroll is theoretically atomic and cheap, but the first thing I meet is a 0%-collateral slider, a red error and a permanent toast covering the fix.
blockers: 05b-swap-cross-bottom: failure-by-default flow with no proposed feasible amount.
05b-swap-cross: toast overlaps the collateral controls needed to resolve it.
No fee/landing-time summary across both legs before commit (fee shown per leg only).

personas.name: Lucas
personas.verdict: Paying and swapping look like any modern wallet and the big Pay button is obvious, but 'Prepare incoming account', 'entity id' and 'lot rounding' would stop me cold.
blockers: 04-receive-bottom: 'YOUR ENTITY ID' with a paragraph is intimidating.
05-swap: lot rounding and bps tariff lines are unexplained jargon.
Receiving $10 requires reading the prepare-account card; buying ETH then needs the swap screen with no simple 'buy' framing.

personas.name: Ingrid
personas.verdict: Enforceable-versus-promised per counterparty, collateral, credit lines and dispute windows are exactly my exposure table; I want it aggregated and exportable.
blockers: 06-account-bottom: exposure per counterparty exists but no portfolio-level per-counterparty table.
06-account: capacity (150) and owed (90) figures coexist without explicit labels.
No way to model 'reduce the promise' (collateralize all) from the exposure view in one action.

personas.name: Omar
personas.verdict: I can see hubs extend credit, hold collateral and settle disputes, and the lending pool hints at earning, but nothing shows a hub's earnings, tariffs or utilization from the operator side.
blockers: 13-lend: pool is all zeros with no rate or utilization, so economics cannot be judged.
05-swap: '1 bps' hub fee is visible but no hub-earnings or tariff configuration surface exists in the set.
06-account: hub semantics are legible to a user, not to a prospective operator (no hub dashboard).
